canonical.title: IT conferences and tech events in Lausanne — what's worth a trip

parent.title: A weekend in Lausanne, anchored on a Michelin dinner

siblings.title: Things to do in Lausanne
siblings.summary: Two-day Lausanne itinerary: Olympic Museum, Plateforme 10, a Lavaux vineyard walk, a CGN paddle steamer, and where to eat between Michelin courses.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Lausanne
siblings.summary: Three top-tier tables anchor a Lausanne weekend: Crissier's 3-star Hôtel de Ville, Pic at Beau-Rivage Palace, and La Table at Lausanne Palace — pick by vibe, location, and how much you want to spend.
